thread:
morgan: Async standup — quick check on API GW / routing policies / auth / rate limits. (What I did / blockers / today)

morgan: What I did: merged jwt-rotation fix to staging and ran smoke tests. Blocker: seeing sporadic 429s on /v1/generate when burst > ~300 rps. Today: triage 429s, audit ratepolicies, canary a relaxed burst limit.

sam: Sam: noticed the same 429 spikes. Looks like the per-route token-bucket for 'public-gen' isn't refilling fast enough. Node metrics show refill latency spikes during bursts. I can push a refill tweak + metric. cc @kevin

anya: Anya: dug into auth logs — ~0.2% 401s during bursts, seems tied to KMS token refreshes (short window). Not primary cause of 429s but increases retries.

kevin: Kevin: quick config Q — for the canary, do we want route-level or service-level burst increases? My preference: service-level so backpressure is smoother across routes.

morgan: morgan: good call. I'll plan a service-level bump for the canary and add a fallback routing policy to route to 'gen-small' if 429 rate remains high. I'll open the PR shortly.

sam: sam: PR review queued. Also added a temporary Grafana panel for token-bucket refill rates: https://grafana.redwood/gw/ratepolicy (dashboard: gw -> ratepolicy -> tokenbucket-refill)

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Deployed morgan/jwt-rotation-fix to staging @ 14:08 UTC

anya: anya: after that deploy I don't see the auth 401s anymore, but short 429 bursts persist. Suggest we enable per-customer emergency quota caps for top talkers to reduce blast radius.

kevin: kevin: agree. I'll draft an emergency rule to throttle any customer > 250 rps down to 200 rps. If people want to test, tell me which customer IDs.

morgan: morgan: plan for today: 1) open canary PR w/ service-level burst bump, 2) run synthetic burst tests against staging, 3) coordinate emergency throttle if results still show 429s. Blocker: need a staging token with high quota. @sam can you provision?

sam: sam: provisioning done — token 'staging-burst-001' added to vault (env: STAGING_BURST_TOKEN). LMK when you want creds.

morgan: morgan: :thumbsup: starting synthetic bursts in ~10m and will post results here.
